The Guest Nightstand in the Guest Bedroom. The handful of things a guest needs in the middle of the night without knocking on your door.

What done looks like:
1. A lamp whose switch you can find by feel in the dark
2. One charging cable per common connector plugged in
3. Reaching the pillow
4. A box of tissues at least half full
